hypothesisMarkdown:
## CSS rules indexed by what their subject needs Hypothesis

The cascade tried every selector of every rule against every element. Each selector is indexed by what its element must have (its first id, else its last class, else its tag; the rest always tried); an element tries those its id, classes and tag name, in the sheet's order.\n\n**Tested mechanism:** selector index. **Allowed:** svg `css.rs` (Index), `Converter::cascade`, a css_selectors test. **Forbidden:** matching semantics.
